# Radial

*Describes reflex-silverpoint-react 0.8.0, wrapping silverpoint 0.8.0.*

Each chart's own props, with the JS name the silverpoint MCP tools and the React docs use. The props
every chart shares (`data`, `title`, `height`, `ground`, `palette`, the events…) are in
[SKILL.md](../../SKILL.md#common-chart-props); the defaults and notes of each prop come from the
MCP's `get_chart`. In each example the rows live in a `rx.State` field passed as `data`.

<!-- generated:family -->

**11 charts:** [`donut_chart`](#donut_chart) · [`radar_chart`](#radar_chart) · [`polar_bar_chart`](#polar_bar_chart) · [`radial_arc_group`](#radial_arc_group) · [`radial_rings`](#radial_rings) · [`gauge_arc`](#gauge_arc) · [`meter_chart`](#meter_chart) · [`coxcomb_chart`](#coxcomb_chart) · [`wind_rose`](#wind_rose) · [`volvelle_chart`](#volvelle_chart) · [`orbit_chart`](#orbit_chart)

## donut_chart

`donut-chart` · `DonutChart` · Sectors ∝ value around a central readout.

Its own props (the common ones are in [SKILL.md](../../SKILL.md#common-chart-props)):

| Python | JS | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `name_key` | `nameKey` | `Accessor<string \| number>` |
| `value_key` | `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` |
| `center_value` | `centerValue` | `string \| number` |
| `center_label` | `centerLabel` | `string` |
| `legend` | `legend` | `boolean` |

```python
import reflex as rx
from reflex_silverpoint_react import donut_chart


class State(rx.State):
    rows: list[dict] = []


def donut_chart_view() -> rx.Component:
    return donut_chart(data=State.rows, title="Donut chart", id="donut-chart")
```

The demo's first rows (read through the accessors' defaults), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[{"name": "Rent", "value": 38}, {"name": "Food", "value": 22}, {"name": "Savings", "value": 15}]
```
